input.subject: Selection Letter — Infosys Systems Engineer
input.message_body:
Dear Candidate,

We are pleased to inform you that you have been selected for the Systems Engineer role at Infosys Ltd. based on your resume profile.

To confirm your joining:
- One-time training & onboarding fee: ₹8,500 (refundable after 6 months)
- Pay via UPI to: infosys.training@okaxis
- Submit your bank statements, PAN, and Aadhaar to the link below

Documentation portal: https://infosys-onboarding.click/upload

Joining date: Within 7 days of payment confirmation.

Regards,
HR Department
Infosys Ltd.
input.conversation_summary: Out of nowhere offer letter. Candidate never applied.
